NinferClient.description: Connection to a local NInfer server. Starts it on first use and lets it shut down once the queue is idle.

auto_start.name: Auto Start
auto_start.tooltip: Start the server if it is not running. Turn this off to use a server you launched yourself with infer.ps1.

model_file.name: Model File
model_file.tooltip: Artifact to load when this node starts the server

idle_seconds.name: Idle Shutdown (s)
idle_seconds.tooltip: Stop the server after this long with no request. NInfer cannot unload a model, so stopping the process is the only way to give the VRAM back to ComfyUI.

api_key.name: API Key
api_key.tooltip: NInfer ignores this header entirely, so the default placeholder is fine locally. It is here so the same nodes can talk to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint that does check credentials. Never leave it empty: an empty api_key makes the openai client fail to connect.

max_retries.name: Max Retries
max_retries.tooltip: Retries on connection errors and 5xx responses

timeout.name: Timeout (s)
timeout.tooltip: Whole-request budget. Generations here run for minutes, so keep this generous.

0.name: Client
0.tooltip: Pass to a NInfer chat node

NinferChat.description: Generates text, optionally conditioned on reference images.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Leave empty to use the first model the server reports

options.name: Options
options.tooltip: Settings chain from the option nodes

force_regen.name: Force Regen
force_regen.tooltip: Always call the model, even when nothing changed

image_1.name: Image 1
image_1.tooltip: Reference image. Connect them in order; each slot adds about 256 prompt tokens at 512px

image_2.name: Image 2
image_2.tooltip: Reference image. Meaningful once Image 1 is wired

image_3.name: Image 3
image_3.tooltip: Reference image. Meaningful once Image 2 is wired

image_4.name: Image 4
image_4.tooltip: Reference image. Meaningful once Image 3 is wired

language.name: Language
language.tooltip: Language for the preview and status text this node prints. ComfyUI's own node labels follow the interface language.

1.name: Reasoning
1.tooltip: Hidden thinking, when the model produced any

NinferServer.description: Drives the NInfer process directly. Useful when a workflow should hold the GPU itself and hand it back when finished.

action.name: Action
action.tooltip: ensure running / stop / keep alive / status

force.name: Force Kill
force.tooltip: Skip the graceful shutdown and kill the process outright

language.name: Language
language.tooltip: Language for the preview and status text this node prints. ComfyUI's own node labels follow the interface language.

NinferOptionSystemPrompt.description: Sets the system prompt, optionally appending a skill file.

skill.name: Skill
skill.tooltip: Markdown file from the skills directory; its contents are appended after the text above

NinferOptionMaxTokens.description: Upper bound on the reply length.

max_tokens.name: Max Tokens
max_tokens.tooltip: Too low and the visible reply comes back empty, because thinking fills the budget first

NinferOptionReasoningEffort.description: Thinking budget. Qwen3.8 thinks by default, so a small max_tokens can leave the reply empty.

reasoning_effort.name: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.tooltip: low is fastest, xhigh thinks longest

NinferOptionTopK.description: Number of top tokens kept at each step.

seed.name: Seed
seed.tooltip: Same seed and settings reproduce the same result

NinferOptionExtraBody.description: Raw JSON for request fields not covered by the other nodes.
